title: Verify before you block on a weak signal
text: Verify before you block on a weak signal: single signal and probability below 0.70 means VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER or STEP_UP_AUTH before any block.

title: Customer denies the transaction
text: Customer denies the transaction: BLOCK_CARD and CREATE_CASE; add FILE_REPORT if exposure exceeds $1,000 or the case connects to a shared device profile or another card's fraud.

title: Customer confirms the transaction
text: Customer confirms the transaction: CLOSE_NO_FRAUD and note the confirmation in the case file.

title: No reply within 24 hours
text: No reply within 24 hours: MONITOR_CARD and DECLINE_TRANSACTION for pending authorizations; escalate if exposure exceeds $500.

title: Card testing
text: Card testing: three or more small online authorizations within an hour, then a larger purchase: DECLINE_TRANSACTION and STEP_UP_AUTH; BLOCK_CARD if a purchase over $100 already cleared.

title: Shared origin
text: Shared origin: several cards with fraud from one device profile, region or recipient email: CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS.

title: Disputed but legitimate
text: Disputed but legitimate: dispute matches the customer's own recurring pattern: CREATE_CASE, VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER, WARN_CUSTOMER. Do not block.

title: Uncertain verdict with exposure over $500, or conflicting evidence
text: Uncertain verdict with exposure over $500, or conflicting evidence: ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST.

title: Undocumented but coordinated abuse across customers
text: Undocumented but coordinated abuse across customers: CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST.

title: Never BLOCK_ALL_CARDS unless two of the customer's cards show confirmed fraud or credentials are confirmed compromised.
text: Never BLOCK_ALL_CARDS unless two of the customer's cards show confirmed fraud or credentials are confirmed compromised.

title: Open a case at probability 0.30, whenever evidence is requested, or whenever a customer disputes a charge. File a report when fraud is confirmed or strongly suspected and exposure exceeds $1,000, or the activity connects to a shared device, region cluster or another customer's fraud, or the pattern is coordinated or undocumented.

title: Stop at probability >= 0.85 or <= 0.15 with two independent pieces of evidence, when verification settles it, or when further steps would not change the decision.
